notes: Selection partition was reused in prior model development; not independent confirmation
DSI/CAS/RAI are proposed summaries of existing concepts, not established novelty
No causal uncertainty attribution or clinical guidance

cas.interpretation: Entropy summaries of calibrated member probabilities; not unique epistemic/aleatoric or causal components

dsi.interpretation: Original 15-variable probability-scale interventional permutation Shapley; finite MC approximation
dsi.limitation: Mixed coalitions may violate correlations; 128/256-record CIs are IID exploratory, not survey-aware

rai.mode: Fixed predictor with training-fitted imputation; NOT subset retraining
rai.interpretation: Equal weights across seven declared scenarios; saturation hides improvement, raw losses retained
rai.limitation: Simulated MCAR/age-associated masking is not an estimate of real deployment missingness

acquisition.interpretation: kNN empirical conditional donors; expected model-implied entropy reduction, not causal/clinical value
limitations: No defensible measurement costs; unit feature counts
Numeric donor values grouped into four quantile bins
No claim of clinical measurement recommendations
